# Lessons

- The root `README.md` can drift from the live workspace tree; when refreshing repo docs here, rebuild the structure from actual folders, project files, and script inventories instead of carrying forward old subproject names.
- In PowerShell scripts that enable `Set-StrictMode`, guard reads of `$args`; direct access can fail on normal parameterized runs when no unbound arguments were supplied.
- When `compress-to-sources.ps1` reloads `CommandHistory` from JSON, normalize `Timestamp` values back to ISO 8601 because `ConvertFrom-Json` may surface prior ISO strings as `DateTime` values and change their serialized format on the next save.
- In `compress-to-sources.ps1`, `FlatOutput` now means more than “no subfolders”: the flat path also packs one mixed-extension chunk set, so changing that behavior requires checking both output paths and chunk grouping logic.
- In `compress-to-sources.ps1`, AI-oriented compaction should target bundle wrappers, not the source text itself; `AiCompact` is safe because it shrinks headers and markers while leaving file content untouched.
- In `compress-to-sources.ps1`, the safest aggressive reductions are format-aware top-of-file cleanup and whitespace normalization; compare the result against a `Preserve` baseline using the same chunk assignment so savings numbers stay meaningful.
- In `compress-to-sources.ps1`, persist `LastUsed` only after a successful run; saving it before path validation or export work can overwrite `compress-to-sources.json` with invalid CLI paths from failed invocations.
- In `compress-to-sources.ps1`, launch seeding should overlay only `InputFolder` and `OutputFolder` from `LastUsed`; merging full `LastUsed` into active profile defaults can silently replace active profile filter lists (extensions/names/ignores).
- For repo-wide PowerShell verb cleanup, validate against `Get-Verb` with a workspace scan; VS Code diagnostics can temporarily keep showing the old offending function names after a rename even when the file text is already correct.
- In `scripts/linearize-branch.ps1`, LLM commit rewrite is most reliable when prompts are sent one commit at a time; batching full history can over/under-generate lines and break replay alignment, especially with multiline commit messages.
- For WinAppSDK desktop builds, `Microsoft.Windows.SDK.BuildTools` can resolve `WindowsSDKBuildToolsBinVersionedArchFolder` to a non-existent package bin path; add an explicit fallback to installed Windows Kits `bin\<version>\<arch>` and override tool paths (`makepri`, `makeappx`, `signtool`, `mt`) from that folder.
- PRI warnings like invalid language qualifiers (`zh-cn`, `zh-tw`) and neutral-resource warnings (`st.js`) can come from Monaco filenames when they flow through `ContentFilesProjectOutputGroup`; moving Monaco to `None` with copy metadata preserves runtime assets while removing them from PRI indexing.
- Under `dotnet msbuild` on this machine, `MSBuildExtensionsPath` points into the .NET SDK and `VsInstallRoot` is empty, so Appx symbol tooling (`mspdbcmf.exe`) may not be auto-discovered; use a conditional fallback rooted at `$(ProgramFiles)\Microsoft Visual Studio\...\AppxPackage` to populate `MsPdbCmfExeFullpath`.
- For installer-style PowerShell scripts in this repo, keep `-WhatIf` preview paths non-elevated and side-effect free: gate elevation relaunch behind `-not $WhatIfPreference`, and guard state/config writes with `ShouldProcess` so dry runs never trigger UAC prompts or write files.
- For copy-based installers, always guard against source and destination resolving to the same path before any remove-and-copy step; without this check, a self-install can delete the running payload.
- For uninstall flows, default to requiring install-state metadata and make metadata-free cleanup opt-in (for example, explicit `-AllowNoState`) to reduce accidental destructive runs against arbitrary folders.
- In `installed-apps-report.ps1`, winget columns can shift or be localized; parsing should handle custom widths or fallback gracefully to non-elevated Appx package listings for the current user when global queries are blocked.
- In `multirepo-tooling.ps1`, history export over multiple repositories should write both per-repo and merged chronological summaries to avoid timezone or interleaving mismatches.
- In `install-tools-artifact.ps1`, check if `-TargetRoot` resides within the payload folder to prevent recursive self-installation.
